summary: Hệ thống Security Operations Center dựa trên AI mã nguồn mở, tự động hóa việc fusion cảnh báo, điều tra LLM-agent và tuân theo MITRE ATT&CK, có thể self-host mà không cần khóa API.
usecases: Automated threat detection and analysis within SOC environments.
LLM-agent triage of security alerts to reduce response time.
MITRE ATT&CK compliance investigation and replayable decision ledger for incidents.
ideas: Integration with existing SIEM platforms to enhance analysis capabilities.
Development of automatic incident response modules.
Application in purple team exercises and security training scenarios.
